recommended_test: LD + indirect bilirubin + haptoglobin + peripheral smear + direct antiglobulin test
rationale: Confirm haemolysis and screen for an immune cause (most HA in this cohort was autoimmune)

recommended_test: Biochemistry panel (ferritin, iron, UIBC, LD) -> Tier 2
rationale: Not resolved by the CBC: escalate

recommended_test: Biochemistry panel (ferritin, iron, UIBC, LD) -> Tier 2
rationale: Low confidence: escalate and flag for review

recommended_test: Biochemistry panel (ferritin, iron, UIBC, LD) -> Tier 2
rationale: Stage 1 predicts another cause: verify with biochemistry

recommended_test: Clinical evaluation for iron therapy; repeat CBC after treatment
rationale: Iron deficiency supported by CBC and iron studies

recommended_test: Haemolysis work-up (indirect bilirubin, haptoglobin, smear, DAT) + haematology consultation
rationale: Haemolysis supported by CBC and LD: investigate the cause

recommended_test: Haemoglobin HPLC / electrophoresis; if HbA2 is normal and iron is replete, alpha-globin molecular testing; genetic counselling
rationale: Carrier state likely; alpha-thalassaemia trait can have a normal HPLC

recommended_test: Investigate other causes (CRP, creatinine/eGFR, vitamin B12, folate, reticulocyte response)
rationale: Not one of the four classes after biochemistry

recommended_test: Specialist review of the CBC, smear and biochemistry
rationale: Still uncertain after biochemistry: human review
